name: Calendar & Idea Agent
title_zh: 日历上每格都长出当天的灵感芽
tagline_zh: 受够了日历只有会议和截止日？它把每个日期变成灵感孵化器——早上看是待办，晚上看是素材，周末看是回顾。
tagline_en: Tired of calendars full of meetings? This turns each date into an idea incubator—todos by day, material by night.
why_zh: 它不把日历当时间轴，而当成一块可播种的田。每个格子自动关联历史笔记与当日主题。
why_en: It treats the calendar not as a timeline but as a field to sow. Each cell auto-links past notes with the day's theme, letting.
limit_zh: 只覆盖日历视图内的想法生成，不接外部任务管理或笔记库；需要你已有至少两周的历史日历数据，否则生成的关联灵感会显得空洞。
limit_en: Only generates ideas within the calendar view; no external task/note integration. Requires 2+ weeks of calendar history, or suggestions feel hollow.
title_en: Calendar that sprouts daily ideas in every cell
